# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This corpus is a large mixed bag of call snippets. The majority are **not real sales conversations** — they are internal logistics chatter (vehicle/driver coordination, Porter/auto bookings, security-gate directions), Diwali-gift distribution/collection logistics to dealers, payment-collection follow-ups, and voice-note noise (wrong numbers, "Manipal Steel" misdial, random personal chat about Diwali travel/allergies). These were excluded from analysis per instructions.

After filtering, there is a genuine but modest set of **real sales calls**: inbound enquiries for roofing sheets/accessories (rate requests, thickness/color/quantity questions), a few outbound cold calls ("Crayon Roofing and Structures-ல இருந்து call பண்ணிருக்கேன்... Roofing sheets requirement இருக்குங்களா Sir?"), dealer/stockist rate-negotiation and scheme calls, and detailed custom-order/measurement calls for bent sheets, L-flash, cutters and ridges. This is enough to extract real pricing, real objections, and real phrasing patterns, but the sample is not large — treat the "rates" below as **directional**, not an exhaustive price list, since several rates (e.g., JSW Color On Plus) appear differently across calls depending on thickness/brand variant and date (one rep even flags "rate ரொம்ப அதிகமா இருக்கு sir... increase ஆகப்போகுது").

## Products & brand ladder

Crayon Roofing & Structures (factory: Manali, Andarkuppam check post, Chennai) sells/fabricates:

- **Metal roofing sheets (core product)** — brands used/discussed: **JSW** (Color On Plus, Pragathi/Pragati, Radiance, Silver On), **Asian** (Indradhanush/Indira Dhanush, Force) — thicknesses 0.45mm, 0.47mm, 0.50mm, 0.6mm; colors: sky blue, off white/half white, royal blue, dark green ("Kali Shelt Green"), grey.
  - "நம்ம metal roofing sheet பண்ணிட்டு இருக்கோம்" [We only manufacture metal roofing sheets] — standard line used to redirect UPVC/MS-corrugated/GI enquiries.
- **Puff/sandwich panels** (wall panel + roof panel, 30/40/50mm thickness) — for cold-room/AC-room/industrial sheds; separate factory from the sheet-rolling unit.
- **Polycarbonate sheets** (Lexan brand) — 1.5mm, 1.8mm, 2mm standard stock; clear/transparent for skylights; max standard length 15 ft ("பாலிகார்ப்னேட் 15 அடி தான் standard, அதுக்கு மேல நம்மளால பண்ண முடியாது").
- **Accessories** — L-flash, ridge, gutter, cutter (custom bent flashing), crimp — made to diagram/drawing, priced by width band (e.g., ₹655 if within 610mm standard width, double rate if full-sheet width used).
- **Screws** — Tata brand (self-drilling/self-tapping, full-thread), rust-free variants, M8, 1"/2" sizes; also "Agri-Go" screw brand.
- **Welding rods** — Tata brand plus a cheaper "Raasi" alternative discussed by a reseller.
